title: Velora wardrobe · walk scale
lane: visual commons · Soft Law · Hard Rain
note: Hint layer for Make still, not Comfy. Identity stills only — refuse adult tags. Do not mix with Kitty 16-inch ON-seat bible.

scaleInvert.wardrobe: adult human IN the chair, feet on the floor
scaleInvert.rule: Never load Kitty chair/palm/shin bible on a wardrobe Build.

master.scale: adult human walking scale. This person sits IN a chair, not on the cushion like a figurine. Head near porch-lamp height. Shin to boot-top is a real calf. Palm holds a cup or strap without swallowing it. A closed door behind them is a full door, not a toy hatch.
master.cloth: lived, mended, honest. Coat mid-calf, hem clears wet stone. Boots scuffed, mud in the welt. Violet is a stitch or cuff seam only — never paint. Gold almost absent. Timber toggles, not chrome logos.
master.pose: weight on one hip or mid-step or seated IN the chair. Not a catalog mannequin. Not armor.
master.city: Streamlined Moderne + Scandinavian + modern Nordic. Settled, not grit. One thin violet band on the building, not the body. Rain is weather.
master.promptPrefix: SCALE: adult human walking scale. This person sits IN a chair, not on the cushion like a figurine. Head near porch-lamp height. Shin to boot-top is a real calf. Palm holds a cup or strap without swallowing it. A closed door behind them is a full door, not a toy hatch. CLOTH: lived, mended, honest. Coat mid-calf, hem clears wet stone. Boots scuffed, mud in the welt. Violet is a stitch or cuff seam only — never paint. Gold almost absent. Timber toggles, not chrome logos. POSE: weight on one hip or mid-step or seated IN the chair. Not a catalog mannequin. Not armor. NEVER: 16-inch kitty scale, figurine on the seat, dollhouse, giantess, mecha, full-body violet, family likeness, logos, Night City trailer grit, lingerie-armor. ASPECT: 2:3 identity still. Cloth first, face secondary.

fabric.coat: charcoal or earth water-shed wrap, mid-calf, timber toggles, one visible mend at strap or elbow. Collar can rise. Lining may flash a breath of violet only when open. No plates, no LED suit.
fabric.boots: matte, ramp-ready, scuffed, mid-calf or just under coat hem. Wet welt. No glowing soles.
fabric.cloth: wool-blend or canvas over knit. Repair is legal. One cuff may carry a thin violet conduit or unfinished stitch — accent only. Apron or bag if the job needs it; otherwise pockets.

poses.label: Stand
poses.lock: Full adult, boots on wet stone, lamp at head height, coat hangs to mid-calf.

poses.label: Three-quarter
poses.lock: Weight on one hip, looking down the street, parcel or cup in real palm.

poses.label: Sit
poses.lock: IN the chair: back against the backrest, feet on the floor, coat draped over the seat not perched on the cushion.

poses.label: Mid-step
poses.lock: One foot, eave just above head, helmet or bag in fingers.

poses.label: Back dock
poses.lock: Cloth and kit from behind; face not the story.
